about.title: The Angolan partner for strategic sourcing and local content.
about.lead: ENERYETU is an Angolan industrial services and solutions company supporting the Oil & Gas and Mining sectors through Strategic Sourcing, Technical Consulting, Skilled Manpower, and specialised industrial services.
about.body1: We are a service provider company operating in the Oil & Gas and Mining Industries, fully Angolan-owned, founded by Angolan professionals with over 15 years of experience in Project Management within the Oil & Gas sector.
about.body2:
We are an ESG-focused company (Environmental, Social & Governance), committed to sustainable practices, environmental stewardship, and supporting the energy transition within the industrial and oil e gas sectors.

We have deep knowledge of the Angolan Oil market and we are keen to establish strategic partnerships that generate mutual value for companies, investors, partners, employees, and local communities.
about.vision: To be a leading African platform for Strategic Sourcing and Local Content, connecting global capabilities with opportunities in Angola and across the continent, and positioning Angola as a strategic gateway and competitive hub for global Oil & Gas and heavy industry supply chains.
about.mission: To create and facilitate business opportunities for national and international companies in Angola and across African markets through integrated Strategic Sourcing, Local Content, market access, and business development solutions, fostering sustainable value for clients, partners, local industries, and communities.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.body: Find answers to the most common questions about our services, sectors, and how we operate.

items.question: What services does ENERYETU provide?
items.answer: We provide strategic sourcing, consulting & intermediation, manpower supply, logistics & supply chain, materials supply, maintenance & repair, water treatment, engineering & construction, integrity management, fabric maintenance & painting, renewable energy, waste management, industrial cleaning, fabrication & construction of structures, technical assistance, and mechanical/electrical/instrumentation services.

items.question: Which industries do you serve?
items.answer: We serve the Oil & Gas, Mining, Renewable Energy, Blue Economy, Transport, Civil Construction, Water Treatment, and Waste Management sectors.

items.question: Where is ENERYETU located?
items.answer: Our head office is located in Luanda, Angola — Apartment 5, 1st floor, building E152, Rua 70, Nova Vida district.

items.question: How can I request a quote?
items.answer: You can request a quote through our Contact page, by calling +244 923 734 199 or +244 945 459 270, or by emailing geral@eneryetu.com. We typically respond within one business day.

items.question: Does ENERYETU offer training programs?
items.answer: Yes. We offer professional training in Project Management, Primavera P6, Welding, and NDT Inspection for national and international teams.

items.question: Is ENERYETU an Angolan-owned company?
items.answer: Yes. We are 100% Angolan-owned, founded by Angolan professionals with over 15 years of experience in Project Management within the Oil & Gas sector.

items.question: What is ENERYETU's approach to ESG?
items.answer: We are an ESG-focused company committed to sustainable practices, environmental stewardship, and supporting the energy transition within the industrial and oil & gas sectors.

items.question: How can I apply for a job at ENERYETU?
items.answer: You can apply through our Careers page by submitting a spontaneous application, or by sending your CV to geral@eneryetu.com mentioning your area of interest.
